summary: Beazer Homes USA Inc. issued $400M 8.000% Senior Notes due 2032 via private placement to QIBs and offshore investors under Rule 144A/Regulation S. Net proceeds will redeem $357.3M of its 5.875% Senior Notes due 2027. The indenture includes standard incurrence covenants, change-of-control put at 101%, and issuer call options with make-whole premium (Treasury+0.50%) and 35% equity-clawback at 108.000%. This is a routine refinancing of existing high-yield debt, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, or other transformative corporate event is present.
